title: SignalDesk — Voice-of-Customer Insights
tagline: A Voice-of-Customer tool that turns messy customer feedback into prioritized product issues backed by evidence.
description: SignalDesk is a Voice-of-Customer tool that turns messy customer feedback into prioritized product issues backed by evidence. Built to help PMs move from 'What are customers saying?' to 'What should we fix?'

caseStudy.problem: Customer feedback is everywhere. Product insight isn’t. Recurring problems drown in noise.
caseStudy.solution: Built a deterministic workflow linking raw quotes directly to prioritized issues with PII masking.
highlights: Evidence-backed issue cards with raw customer quote verification
Deterministic frequency, recency, and impact score calculations
Exportable product roadmap & issue summaries for stakeholders

title: DAHLIA — A Personal Memory Garden
tagline: DAHLIA turns everyday photos into a quiet, visual record of the year—one memory per day, one growing garden.
description: DAHLIA turns everyday photos into a quiet, visual record of the year—one memory per day, one growing garden. Designed to be calm instead of productive, private instead of public, and for ordinary days.

caseStudy.problem: Camera rolls are full, but memories feel invisible. Journals add pressure.
caseStudy.solution: Built a visual memory garden where each photo grows a unique botanical memory.
highlights: Pick a date, add one photo, watch a flower appear in your garden
Calendar navigation across months and years with botanical identities
Calm, private, minimal design stored locally without streaks or pressure

title: StreakUp — Challenge-Based Habit Tracker
tagline: StreakUp is a challenge-based habit tracker built around showing progress, not just checking boxes.
description: StreakUp is a challenge-based habit tracker built around showing progress, not just checking boxes. Built to make consistency feel visible, flexible, and motivating.

caseStudy.problem: Most habit trackers focus on individual tasks, but don't make longer-term progress feel meaningful.
caseStudy.solution: Turned habits into time-bound challenges (21, 30, 66, 90 days) with visible streaks and progress calendars.
highlights: Streaks, progress calendars, notes, and challenge templates
Lightweight, login-free, local-first daily habit experience

title: Speech & Pain Assessment ML for Cerebral Palsy
tagline: A machine-learning application for speech clarity assessment and facial-expression-based pain detection for individuals with cerebral palsy.
description: A machine-learning application for speech clarity assessment and facial-expression-based pain detection for individuals with cerebral palsy. Rebuilt from the original college project report into a working web application.

caseStudy.problem: Individuals with cerebral palsy may experience difficulty with speech clarity and communicating discomfort.
caseStudy.solution: Built a dual ML workflow: MFCC+KNN for speech clarity and InceptionV3 for facial-expression pain detection.
highlights: Speech clarity analysis using MFCC feature extraction and KNN classification
Facial expression pain detection using InceptionV3 neural networks
Full-stack web application connecting Next.js/TypeScript UI with FastAPI/Python ML backend

title: together. — AI Fintech Stack Optimizer
tagline: An AI-powered fintech stack optimizer that helps users build and improve their financial app setup.
description: together. is an AI-powered fintech stack optimizer built to help beginners understand what they use, what they need, and what they can simplify.

caseStudy.problem: With so many fintech apps available, beginners struggle to know which products actually fit their needs.
caseStudy.solution: Built an AI-driven stack recommendation engine analyzing user goals, detecting overlaps, and optimizing app setups.
highlights: AI/LLM natural-language goal extraction and profile scoring engine
Stack gap and overlap analysis across saving, investing, and spending
Natural-language Stack Advisor with interactive app comparison

title: Product Thinking & Teardowns
tagline: A collection of product analyses and case studies exploring how existing digital products can be improved through user-focused thinking, feature analysis, and product strategy.
description: A collection of product analyses and case studies exploring how existing digital products can be improved through user-focused thinking, feature analysis, and product strategy. Includes teardowns and improvement ideas for products such as Google, CRED, Slice, Stripe, Groww.

caseStudy.problem: Digital products evolve rapidly, but feature changes often lack clear user intent or evidence-backed rationale.
caseStudy.solution: Published in-depth teardowns analyzing UX flaws, onboarding funnels, and retention drivers for Google, CRED, Slice, Stripe, and Groww.
highlights: In-depth feature teardowns & redesign proposals for top consumer and fintech apps
User funnel and friction point identification backed by product heuristics
Interactive Notion knowledge base with case studies and strategic breakdowns
